entries.title: Pre Retirement Income Readiness Review
entries.descriptionPattern: Invite clients approaching retirement to review projected income needs, existing resources and planning gaps with an adviser.
entries.messagingPattern: Offer an educational retirement-readiness conversation focused on understanding current arrangements and possible next steps, without implying a guaranteed outcome.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Clients nearing common retirement transition years may benefit from an income-readiness review.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Multiple cash bands keep the campaign educational and avoid assuming a single wealth profile.

requiredDisclaimers: Educational information only; any recommendation requires an individual fact-find and suitability assessment.

entries.title: Retirement Healthcare Cost Check
entries.descriptionPattern: Encourage older clients to review how healthcare expenses and existing protection may affect their retirement plan.
entries.messagingPattern: Invite a review of healthcare funding assumptions and existing coverage, while making clear that coverage and needs vary by individual.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Healthcare funding is commonly relevant near and during retirement.
targetingRationale.genders: The educational topic applies regardless of gender.
targetingRationale.cashBands: No cash threshold is inferred from the objective.

requiredDisclaimers: Coverage, exclusions and suitability depend on individual circumstances and must be reviewed with an adviser.

entries.title: Annual Family Protection Review
entries.descriptionPattern: Invite clients to review whether existing protection still reflects their dependants, liabilities and current life stage.
entries.messagingPattern: Frame the outreach as a no-obligation coverage review and explain that any gap analysis requires up-to-date personal information.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Working-age clients may experience changing family and liability needs.
targetingRationale.genders: Protection needs should not be inferred from gender.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Protection review relevance is not limited to a cash band.

requiredDisclaimers: Any protection recommendation is subject to fact-finding, affordability and suitability review.

entries.title: Income Resilience Conversation
entries.descriptionPattern: Start an educational review of how a temporary or extended loss of income could affect essential commitments.
entries.messagingPattern: Use scenario-based questions to help clients understand income risks and invite an adviser-led review of existing safeguards.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: The theme is most directly relevant during working years.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Lower and middle liquid-cash bands may have less buffer, but individual circumstances still require review.

requiredDisclaimers: This is general education and not a conclusion about any client's protection gap or suitable product.

entries.title: Early Education Funding Checkpoint
entries.descriptionPattern: Help parents or prospective parents estimate education goals, time horizons and existing savings before considering solutions.
entries.messagingPattern: Invite clients to an educational planning session that compares their goal timeline with current savings assumptions.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: These age bands commonly include clients starting or raising families, without assuming parental status.
targetingRationale.genders: Education planning applies to all parents and guardians.
targetingRationale.cashBands: A broad range supports goal-setting without presuming affordability.

requiredDisclaimers: Illustrations are not guarantees; recommendations require a personal affordability and suitability assessment.

entries.title: Tertiary Education Goal Review
entries.descriptionPattern: Review progress toward a stated tertiary-education goal and identify assumptions that need updating as the target date approaches.
entries.messagingPattern: Ask clients to revisit the expected timing, cost range and current resources for an education goal before discussing options.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: These age bands may include households with medium-term education goals, subject to confirmation.
targetingRationale.cashBands: The selected bands are a starting hypothesis, not an affordability decision.

requiredDisclaimers: Costs and returns are uncertain; planning assumptions and suitability must be reviewed individually.

entries.title: Beneficiary And Nomination Review
entries.descriptionPattern: Prompt clients to check whether beneficiary and nomination records still reflect their intentions after life changes.
entries.messagingPattern: Offer a practical records review and explain when legal or specialist advice may be needed.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Nomination reviews can become more relevant as family and asset arrangements develop.
targetingRationale.cashBands: A nomination review can be useful regardless of liquid cash.

requiredDisclaimers: This campaign provides general information and is not legal, tax or financial advice.

entries.title: Estate Liquidity Education
entries.descriptionPattern: Introduce the concept of estate liquidity and invite clients to review whether intended transfers rely on assumptions that need professional advice.
entries.messagingPattern: Provide a plain-language overview of estate liquidity and direct clients to appropriate legal, tax or advisory professionals for personal decisions.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Later life stages may make legacy intentions more immediate, without excluding earlier planning.
targetingRationale.genders: The topic applies regardless of gender.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Higher liquid-asset bands may indicate more complex transfer considerations, but do not establish need or suitability.

requiredDisclaimers: General education only; obtain qualified legal and tax advice for estate arrangements.

entries.title: First Home Financial Readiness
entries.descriptionPattern: Help prospective first-home buyers review cash flow, emergency reserves and protection considerations before committing to a purchase.
entries.messagingPattern: Invite clients to map the financial commitments around a home purchase and identify questions for the relevant property, lending and advisory professionals.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Younger adult groups commonly contain first-home prospects, but intent must be confirmed.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Several bands support education across different deposit and reserve positions.

requiredDisclaimers: This is general financial education, not lending, property, legal or tax advice.

entries.title: Mortgage Commitment Protection Check
entries.descriptionPattern: Invite property owners to review how existing arrangements would support mortgage commitments during adverse life events.
entries.messagingPattern: Use an educational checklist covering outstanding liabilities, household income dependency and existing protection before any recommendation.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: These groups may be more likely to have ongoing property liabilities, subject to confirmation.
targetingRationale.genders: Liability reviews should not be targeted by gender.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Mortgage commitments cannot be inferred from available cash alone.

requiredDisclaimers: Any recommendation depends on verified liabilities, existing coverage, affordability and suitability.

entries.title: Emergency Savings Resilience Review
entries.descriptionPattern: Encourage clients to review essential spending, accessible reserves and priorities for improving short-term financial resilience.
entries.messagingPattern: Offer a practical educational check-in on emergency savings and cash-flow assumptions without prescribing a product.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Financial resilience can be relevant throughout working life.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Lower available-cash bands may make reserve planning more immediately relevant, without proving a shortfall.

requiredDisclaimers: General education only; an individual review is required before taking financial action.

entries.title: Mid Career Financial Plan Checkpoint
entries.descriptionPattern: Invite mid-career clients to revisit competing goals, existing arrangements and changes since their last financial review.
entries.messagingPattern: Position the conversation as an educational checkpoint that updates facts and priorities before any advice is considered.

targetingRationale.ageGroups: Mid-career years often involve several competing goals and changing responsibilities.
targetingRationale.genders: The review objective is not gender-specific.
targetingRationale.cashBands: Broad cash bands avoid assuming a single planning need or solution.

requiredDisclaimers: Any recommendation requires current facts, risk profiling, affordability and suitability assessment.
